My Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2018/HW/393.Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No.: 4/1/1/32-J.

Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,No. 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.23rd April, 2019.
